'''2018 US Nationals Jonathan Murray LS They Have No Idea We're Coming''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonathan Murray]] at [[2018 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonathan Murray]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|They Have No Idea We're Coming / Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent|V9-L-theyhavenoideawerecoming.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127141216/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ Internet Archive]
